title: incident-bot: improved runbook triggers and on-call runbook previews
author: Aisha Thomas
release_notes:
- incident-bot: Add configurable runbook trigger rules and preview mode for on-call runbook links.
- slo-toolkit: New helper to emit runbook suggestion signals for diagnostics.
- Docs: Add runbook-preview and rollout guidance for on-call responders.
description:
Context: On a few recent incidents responders needed faster access to runbooks and better selectors for when to auto-trigger diagnostics. This PR improves incident-bot's runbook triggering logic and adds a runbook-preview feature that posts a summarized link into on-call channels before automatic execution. Motivation: reduce mean-time-to-resolution by surfacing relevant runbooks earlier and avoid noisy auto-executions.

What this does:
- Adds a rule engine for runbook triggers (incident-bot/src/runbook_triggers.py). Rules are configurable by service, severity, and SLO breach type.
- Adds a runbook-preview flow that posts a summarized link + metadata to the on-call channel and waits configurable approval window (default 30s) before executing automated diagnostics. This prevents noisy diagnostics during noisy alerts.
- Integrates with slo-toolkit to surface runbook suggestion signals derived from SLI anomalies (slo-toolkit/runbook_suggester.py).
- Backfills runbook metadata for older services and exposes a dry-run flag used by the preview flow.
- Adds unit and integration tests and updates docs + helm values for toggling the feature.

Checklist:
- [x] Rule engine implementation and unit tests
- [x] Runbook-preview flow and channel UX tests
- [x] slo-toolkit integration and feature flag wiring
- [x] Docs and rollout notes
- [x] Feature gated behind incident-bot.feature.runbook_preview (default: false)

Compatibility and rollout: The feature is behind a feature flag (incident-bot.feature.runbook_preview). Default is off. We will enable for staging only and run a 48h canary before toggling prod for a subset of critical services. No breaking changes to existing webhook payloads.

Testing: Unit tests for rule matching + preview timeout handling added. Integration tests simulate Slack/Teams message flow in the test harness. E2E smoke run executed in staging during the canary.

Security: No secrets added. Runbook URLs are scoped to internal runbook viewer and tokenized.

Related: SUP-784, ENG-2412, previous PRs that added on-call summaries and runbook links (pr-22541, pr-27105).
